what_happens: The Hugging Face parquet cannot be downloaded.
what_the_pipeline_does: The stage fails; everything downstream is recorded `blocked`, not `failed`, so the ledger names one defect rather than ten.

what_happens: A fresh clone has no `data/`, and the competitor set reads the 75 MB full cache the collector leaves behind.
what_the_pipeline_does: `requires` carries the edge, so the plan runs `collect` first. This is the edge that was undeclared before Task 11.

what_happens: No Adzuna keys in the environment.
what_the_pipeline_does: Backfill-only, which is the committed dataset anyway. Recorded as a source verdict, not a failure.

what_happens: A pandas or numpy release changes a default under unchanged code.
what_the_pipeline_does: The weekly verify run reports `drifted` with the artefact list. This is the only thing the schedule can find on a frozen source, and it is why the schedule exists.

what_happens: Every report carries the wall clock, so bytes always move.
what_the_pipeline_does: Stable digests strip the registered clock keys, so the run reports `volatile_only` instead of committing ten meaningless lines.

what_happens: A live public feed returns different postings every call.
what_the_pipeline_does: Declared `source_volatile` and kept out of the schedule; the audit reports that its output is nonetheless committed.

what_happens: The deck counts a repository that later tasks keep changing.
what_the_pipeline_does: `fact_drift` compares the committed register against the live one, so the stale key can be named rather than merely detected.
